_about: Shape of MFL's TYPE=calendar export (normalizeMflCalendar fields: type, start_time, end_time, title, id). Events = the three 'No Trades Allowed' (TRADE) entries MFL's public League Calendar page showed on 2026-10-21 00:23 UTC (Tue 11-24 12:00 PM ET; Wed 11-25 8:00 PM ET twice), plus one waiver event as noise. The export itself needs a signed-in league member.
